artworks.title: Architectural Fantasy with Roman Ruins
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Melissa J. Stegeman in honor of Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image depicts an elevated view looking into a courtyard or open space surrounded by architectural ruins. The horizon blends into the distant ruins, old structures, and arches. The artwork is an etching with detailed line work and fine, sketch-like brushstrokes defining the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, using black ink and ivory paper for depth. Closest are three figures near a rectangular base, with a broken column and scattered remnants. More figures are seen in the space, amid weathered structures and trees. The right side shows a large building with an archway, covered with vines and foliage.

artworks.title: A Terrace and Garden on Capri [recto]
artworks.medium: charcoal and white chalk on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a view from a shaded veranda or pergola looking outward through a series of columns. The horizon is obscured by dense foliage with a central palm tree dominating the scene. Architectural elements indicate a building with a dome in the distance. The artwork uses soft, smooth strokes in a monochromatic grey-blue palette. Closest to us, the columns frame the scene, leading the eye towards the blending of structural and natural elements. The overall effect is serene, with blue tones and careful linework creating a harmonious balance.

artworks.title: View up a Street in Sorrento [verso]
artworks.medium: charcoal and white chalk on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street-level perspective of a narrow alleyway between tall buildings with trees on one side. A seated figure is on the right near the viewer. A woman and a child are walking down the street. The sketch is done in pencil on blue-toned paper, creating a sense of form and depth with light, fluid lines. The color palette is minimal, highlighting the blue paper as the background with shading variations from the pencil work, emphasizing shadows and shapes.

artworks.title: Palatial Mantelpiece with a Scene of Ancient Sacrifice [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an architectural sketch with ornate details. The drawing features a detailed section of an architectural design with elaborate ornamentation and mythical figures. The top part displays a decorative frieze with human figures and intricate vegetal motifs. Beneath this, an archway or doorway is adorned with carvings of human figures. There are columns and pilasters with sculpted human forms integrated into the design. The drawing includes a cartouche in the center with a date inscribed as 'ANNO D.O.M. 1571'. The style of the drawing suggests a focus on classical architectural elements typical of the period.

artworks.title: Wall Monument with an Armillary Sphere [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural facade. The sketch shows detailed curved and symmetrical lines, intricate scrolls, and decorative elements. The primary focus is on a stylized facade with elaborate Baroque influences in its rich ornamentation. Features include a spherical finial at the top, decorative flourishes, an ornate circular element, small windows or panels, and one filled in with dark shading. There is a sketched figure on the left side. The drawing showcases detailed classical architectural and decorative design typical of grand public buildings or opulent homes.

artworks.title: Diana and Endymion
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral view with trees, foliage, figures, and animals. The brushstrokes are detailed and fluid, emphasizing the natural setting. The color palette consists of sepia tones, gray, and brown. In the forefront, there are dogs interacting with figures reclining on the ground. In the background, trees and shrubbery add depth to the scene, with a faintly lit clearing at the center.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Man
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper part of a person's body, focusing on a side profile of the head and shoulders. The person is in a left-facing profile view, showcasing their facial features in detail. The drawing includes a straight nose, softly defined lips, long wavy hair falling past the shoulders, simple clothing, and a plain background. There are no jewelry or objects in the image.

artworks.title: An Angel in Flight
artworks.medium: black chalk and graphite on brown prepared paper
artworks.description: The image shows a child-like figure in a floating or flying stance, with arms and legs extended. The facial features include a smiling mouth, closed eyes, and wavy hair. The figure is unclothed, with additional sketches of hands nearby. The background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Empire, with the Four Continents
artworks.artist: Alessandro Mauro and Francesco de Mura
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray washes over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene with figures and cherubs. The drawing depicts various mythological characters, cherubic forms, and possibly deities, intertwined with elements of classical architecture, clouds, and foliage. The figures are rendered in a graceful and flowing manner, illustrating movement and energy. The medium primarily uses brown and black tones to create depth and emphasis.

artworks.title: Herdsmen Driving Cattle across a Stream
artworks.medium: oil and brown wash over black chalk on laid paper laid down on board
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene depicting a herd of cattle and sheep with a person guiding them. The animals are depicted with dynamic brushstrokes suggesting movement. Swirling cloud-like formations can be seen in the background. The color palette is warm and earthy, consisting of browns, beiges, and hints of red and blue. Light and shadow are used to add depth to the figures. The style is similar to Peter Paul Rubens, known for capturing dynamic scenes and rich texture.

artworks.title: The Interior of the Colosseum
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on light brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an interior view of an ancient, cavernous structure with stone arches and pillars creating depth. Light filters in through distant openings. The brushstrokes are subtle, using soft and firm lines for texture and shadow on the stone surfaces. The color palette is earthy and muted, with grays and browns. Two figures are close by, reclining against a rock, while another pair is further in the distance, sitting within the ruin.

artworks.title: Worth Going For, Maine
artworks.medium: albumen silver print mounted on cream laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to image): 14.4 x 19.4 cm (5 11/16 x 7 5/8 in.)
mount: 28.2 x 35.7 cm (11 1/8 x 14 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a canoe on a calm body of water with two individuals inside. The canoe is centered with perfect symmetry, and its reflection is visible in the water. The horizon is low with a faint line suggesting distant land. The photograph is in sepia tones, giving it a vintage aesthetic dominated by shades of brown and beige. The transition between water and sky creates a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Whitby Fishermen
artworks.medium: carbon print
artworks.description: This image shows fishing boats near a harbor. The boats are docked near the shore with their sails raised. In the background, there are blurry structures that may be buildings or cliffs. The scene conveys a sense of a harbor in a coastal town.

artworks.title: Im Höllenthal (In the Höllen Valley)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 32.8 x 27.6 cm (12 15/16 x 10 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a wooden bridge crossing over a river in a valley. The scenery includes cliffs, trees, and flowing water below. The artwork features fine, detailed brushstrokes depicting the texture of the cliffs, foliage, and water. The color scheme is monochromatic with various shades of gray and sepia tones. Two figures are seen on the bridge, contributing to the sense of scale and activity in the serene setting.

artworks.title: Fontainebleau
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to image): 32 x 26 cm (12 5/8 x 10 1/4 in.)
mat: 55.9 x 40.6 cm (22 x 16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: The Amy Rose Silverman Fund and Robert B. Menschel Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a path lined with rocks winding through a woodland area with large trees forming a canopy overhead. The detail in the image is sharp, capturing textures of tree bark, leaves, and rocks. The color palette is sepia, with shades of brown and cream. Rocks and foliage dominate the scene, extending into the dense forest where the path disappears among the trees.

artworks.title: View of the Janiculum Hill Seen from the Tiber (recto)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside village with buildings packed along the water's edge. Hills and trees rise in the distance. Two small figures are seated by the water, and a boat with three figures is on the river. Delicate line work is used for architectural and natural details. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones.

artworks.title: Luxembourg, Anne of Brittany
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image shows a sculpture of a figure in robes on an ornate pedestal. The figure is standing upright with hands delicately positioned. The sculpture appears to be made of light-colored stone, possibly marble or limestone. It is located outdoors near leafless tree branches. In the background, there is a large, ornate building with multiple windows. The scale of the sculpture and pedestal makes it appear tall compared to the trees and the viewer's point of view.

artworks.title: Un Débarquement en Angleterre
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, roulette, and spirit ground on antique paper
artworks.description: The image shows a busy dock in the rain, with people arriving under umbrellas. Ships and flagpoles are visible in the horizon against a cloudy sky. The painting is detailed with rain-soaked planks and a crowd of people, giving a sense of movement. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of sepia and dark brown. Lamp posts in the distance softly glow.

artworks.title: L'Entrée de Landemer (Hague)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a figure walking alongside a horse carrying baskets. A path leads towards small thatched-roof cottages surrounded by trees. In the background, there are undulating hills under a cloudy sky. The etching technique creates textures using lines and cross-hatching for shading. The color palette is sepia and black, giving a rustic quality. Ducks can be seen swimming in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Un Grain à Trouville (Squall at Trouville)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a beach scene with people on the sandy area near the sea. A cloud stretches across the sky above the horizon line. In the foreground, people with umbrellas are gathered, next to a pavilion with flags. Boats can be seen on the horizon. The color palette is mainly sepia tones with contrast created through blacks and deep browns, giving a vintage feel to the scene. The atmosphere conveys a bustling day at the beach.

artworks.title: La Petite Marine - Souvenir de Medway (counterproof)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, and roulette in black on wove paper [counterproof]
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from a raised vantage point showing a vast scene of the shore, sea, and sky. The horizon is near the top of the image, emphasizing the sky and a sailing ship. The ship has billowing sails and is a focal point in the scene. The painting features delicate, sketch-like brushstrokes creating movement and texture in the sky and water. Closest to the viewer is a rocky terrain with wooden posts and a broken fence, where a person sits looking at the ship. In the distance on the left is a windmill, adding depth to the image. The color scheme is sepia, evoking a timeless and calm ambiance.

artworks.title: La Place Pigalle en 1878 (Place Pigalle in 1878)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, and roulette with burnishing in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bustling street scene with a horse-drawn carriage and people walking around. The full description captures a lively urban setting, likely from the 19th century, with various modes of transportation such as horse-drawn carriages and depictions of city life. The drawing features buildings, some signage, and what appears to be people interacting on cobbled streets. A central focus seems to be on a large horse-drawn carriage stopped on the street, with several figures around it. The composition also includes an upper inset of a cafe scene, adding depth and showing different aspects of city life, including leisure and transportation. The artwork captures the essence of the era's urban experience with a fine, detailed technique.

artworks.title: Le Retour des Artistes
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a street scene with a dynamic etching style. The composition includes a high horizon line with a distant statue at the center, rain and reflections as key visual elements, and a monochrome color palette of black and white. In the foreground, a group of people walk on a wet surface, with a horse-drawn carriage moving behind them. Moving towards the background, a group of people are gathered in an area with trees on either side, suggesting an urban setting.

artworks.title: La Traversée (The Passage)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, and soft-ground etching in brown on japanese laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts intersecting lines and shapes in an abstract composition. A central scene shows figures with umbrellas ascending a staircase on a structure resembling a ship's deck. Smaller vignettes include a harp sketch, groups of people, and conversing figures. The top section features ship outlines resembling sails on the horizon. The artwork blends everyday activities and elements evoking familiar settings, such as a rainy day by the sea or a gathering place under shelter.
